correctness.rationale: For every n>=2, divide r<n^2 by n+1. Construct an offset representation of r using max(q,s)<=n coins; the largest such representative is at most n^3+n^2-2. For m at least n^3-1, the same residue representative cannot exceed m (otherwise it exceeds that upper bound by at least n^2), so m is representable. Conversely n^3-2 would require at most n-1 nonbase generators with offset sum n^2-2. At most n-2 offsets are too small; exactly n-1 offsets miss by precisely n, while their permitted reductions are either at most n-1 or at least n+1. Direct independently coded shortest-path tests pass for n=2..100 and are only corroborative.
